smallest_change: Keep browser-fetch transport; compare one six-target session with fresh three-target batches. Same six targets and capture settings in both arms.
counts_scope: 36 product requests include control requests, failed attempts and any single diagnostic re-fetch. Listing capture GETs are additional to eight category navigations. Store-selection UI/asset requests are not included; runtime bounds entire job.
publication: Never writes production latest.json; any drift invalidates comparison and stops it. Re-fetch is evidence only.
privacy: Ignored data/ only; complete Fetch-decoded originals plus redaction drafts. No automatic sharing or public body export. Manual privacy review required.
limitations: Cannot prove absence of all silent pricing defects
Fresh-session batching is an unvalidated hypothesis
